own_solution.law: RC charging: V_C(t) = E (1 - exp(-t/(R C))), tau = R C = 5000 ohm * 20e-6 F = 0.1 s
assumptions: capacitor initially uncharged, circuit closed at t = 0

TABC4.regime: Switch-opening time affects V_C(80 ms) only if it is earlier than 80 ms; 500 ms > 80 ms, so the charging transient up to 80 ms is unaffected.

T2215.regime: Disconnection time matters only if earlier than 80 ms; 500 ms > 80 ms.

notes: Base: t/tau = 0.8, V = 12(1 - e^-0.8) = 12 * 0.550671 = 6.608 V. With an extra 2 kohm in series: R = 7 kohm, tau = 0.14 s, t/tau = 0.5714, V = 12(1 - 0.564718) = 5.223 V. The four 2 kohm sentences state the same value and unit and differ only in attachment; the two 500 ms sentences state the same time. Minor: TD742 'is inserted' does not say when, but is naturally read as part of the circuit from the start.
